general-information.label: Effective Date

general-information.label: Expiration Date
general-information.description: Policy expiration date when coverage ends.

general-information.description: Primary broker or producer responsible for the placement.

general-information.label: Global Deal Scope

financials.label: Base Currency
financials.description: Primary currency in which the deal premium and values are quoted.

financials.label: Gross Written Premium (GWP)
financials.description: Total top-line gross premium figure for the full policy term across all lines.

financials.label: Total Insured Value (TIV / TSI)
financials.description: Aggregate exposure limit or sum insured declared across the entire deal container.

review.warning: Total Insured Value (TIV / TSI) has uncertain support in the section evidence and should be reviewed.

financials.label: Broker Commission (%)
financials.description: Overarching broker/producer commission percentage calculated on the GWP.

financials.label: Payment Schedule / Frequency
financials.description: Agreed premium payment schedule installment structure.

financials.label: First Premium Due Date
financials.description: Deadline date for the initial premium payment settlement.

financials.label: Multi-Currency Placement
financials.description: Indicates whether payments/settlements are processed in currencies other than the base currency.

financials.label: Settlement Currency
financials.description: Secondary currency designated for binding and collecting premiums.

financials.label: Policy-Level Surplus Fees / Taxes
financials.description: Top-level statutory taxes, surplus line fees, or stamp duties applied to the total deal.
